title: BUILDING IN FAITH
PROTECT YOUR HOME
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer

scenes.a: You are building safety for your family today.
Hebrews 11 verse 7 says: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house;
by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
Lord, when the future feels uncertain and we cannot see what lies ahead, give us quiet obedience.
Help us guard the souls in our care and build a sanctuary of truth for our children.
Protect our household, Lord, and anchor our hearts in Your holy promise.
Amen. Keep building safety for your family today.
